text.zh-Hans: s2arm.com 不是 S2Arm 的官方网站：它擅自使用 S2Arm 名称并挂出捐款链接。S2Arm 免费开源，从不接受捐赠；第三方网站的下载内容无法鉴别是否被改动或植入后门，请只从官方渠道获取。
text.en: s2arm.com is NOT the official S2Arm website: it uses the S2Arm name without permission and solicits donations. S2Arm is free and open source and never accepts donations. We cannot verify whether anything downloaded from third-party sites has been modified or contains a backdoor; get S2Arm only from the official channels.
